_about: Public-domain Johann Arndt (1555-1621, Lutheran superintendent at Celle) in English for the Word Hoard: True Christianity in A. W. Boehm's translation as revised by Charles F. Schaeffer (Philadelphia, 1868), from Project Gutenberg, and The Garden of Paradise (London: J. Downing, 1716), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

arndt-true-christianity: True Christianity, tr. A. W. Boehm, revised and ed. Charles F. Schaeffer (Philadelphia: Lutheran Book Store; Smith, English & Co., 1868)
